1.en_consolidated_definition: Educ. A public school converted into an autonomous entity in legal and financial terms that operates as a private company. They began to function in 1992 in Minnesota. This is a rare calque of structure. Diaz argued that studies conducted by prestigious American educational institutions have shown that, despite the concept of "charter" being disseminated as an educational panacea, it has not significantly contributed to the academic improvement of students. In addition, it has been strongly criticized by school communities who claim that charter schools promote discrimination.
